verdict.rationale: Zulip's official API documents sending messages, and its bot framework reacts to (reads) messages, so an agent can read and post channel messages through official interfaces. Nothing in the evidence shows scoped or permission-limited tokens, which is a core element of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped/least-privilege API tokens or bot permission scoping, explicit documentation of the message-read/fetch endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration.
